title: Save Snappy's encode tmp table allocation #13826

timeline.body:
Motivation:

Allocating a new byte[] on the hot path is expensive

Modifications:

- Use FastThreadLocal to recycle the byte[] when it's the same size
- Fill the array with 0 to ensure correctness of compression
- Created a Benchmark in the microbench module
- New system property `io.netty.handler.codec.compression.snappy.hashTableType` with possible value `newarray` (default) or `reuse` to use a single buffer

Result:

Fixes #13826
Benchmarks results on #13826

this should be private
```suggestion
   private enum HashType {
```

reply.body: you can drop using an enum and just a boolean property based on the configured sys property: it would work better because will make it a proper constant, for the JIT (see https://shipilev.net/jvm/anatomy-quarks/17-trust-nonstatic-final-fields/ for more info)

timeline.body: As I think `HashType` should be an private enum we need another way how to configure this one... Like a boolean or string

reply.body: Yep, it shouldn't be exposed directly - meaning that @lucamolteni can use its own sys property to do it, wdyt?

timeline.body: Should we also limit the max length for "cached" tables ?

```suggestion
    private static final boolean DEFAULT_REUSE_HASHTABLE = SystemPropertyUtil.getBoolean("io.netty.handler.codec.compression.snappy.reuseHashTable", false);
```

it loose the logging, but is more compact, as `getBoolean` already perform the same thing you're doing there
